description: Multi-target Calibrated Gradient Boosting Classifier predicting coastal highway cutoff and healthcare facility inundation probabilities during severe cyclonic events.

inputFeatures.name: elevation_m
inputFeatures.description: Digital Elevation Model height above mean sea level (meters)

inputFeatures.name: distance_to_coastline_km
inputFeatures.description: Euclidean distance to active coastline/bay shoreline (km)

inputFeatures.name: storm_surge_m
inputFeatures.description: Peak hydrodynamic storm surge inundation height above tide (meters)

inputFeatures.name: accumulated_rain_mm
inputFeatures.description: 24-48hr cumulative precipitation from cyclone spiral bands (mm)

inputFeatures.name: soil_saturation_idx
inputFeatures.description: Antecedent soil moisture saturation index (0.0 to 1.0)

inputFeatures.name: drainage_capacity_score
inputFeatures.description: Local sluice gate & drainage infrastructure capacity (0.0 to 1.0)

inputFeatures.name: embankment_height_m
inputFeatures.description: Engineered roadway embankment or facility floodwall elevation (meters)

modelEvaluation.evaluationDataset: Bay of Bengal Historical Calibrated Coastal Benchmark (n=3,600)
